items: After sailing to an island, and after sleeping in the bed, the witch is in her nightie in bed from the first moment you see her, no longer in last night's clothes; her nightie is drawn once and kept, so it's ready every morning
Landing in the bedroom after a sail, the camera no longer jumps as the flight ends: it comes down on her in bed and stays there

Sailing from the sea chart, the island starts being made as soon as you choose it, and the flight in starts as soon as its map is ready, showing the island as it's built, with mist over what isn't yet, instead of a blue screen and then a cut to the bed
